text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kh... I fell off at the exact same spot 
again. And I was so close, too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Are you having trouble with 
climbing? Then let me impart to you my 
very best practice method!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That would be... becoming best friends 
with your hat!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Climbing is such a lonely, brutal sport! 
But—once you deepen your bond with your 
hat, you're not alone!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When Rice... tried being friends with it, 
Mr. Hat gave me strength... and my times 
improved, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: G-Getting along with my hat... you say...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, you know... Cheval-chan has a nice hat 
too, right!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh. ...Wait, WHAT!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Basking in the sun feels so nice, 
Aimun-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Cheval-chan, join in! Let's 
lounge around together with your precious 
hat~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...H-How did things end up like 
this...?!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that was such a lovely story, 
Oryza-san... ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice reads her favorite picture books 
together with Mr. Hat, you see. Would you 
like to join, Chevalier-san...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! ...Ummm... Would a photobook of the 
sea... be okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Th-Thanks for always coming fishing 
with me. Um... Marine-chan."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I wonder if it goes something like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Your bond with the hat is 
deepening! Well then, let's head back to 
the academy and—try again!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Hah, ah...! I climbed this far...! Next 
is... that hold I can never seem to 
grab...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It'll be okay! I'm sure you can do it— if 
it's you, Cheval-chan, and Marine-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Can a hat really give someone 
strength, I wonder if that's even 
possible... but—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even when I was all alone... you were 
always there by my side.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(To you, sitting right on top of my 
head... I don't want to show you such a 
pathetic side of me!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I did…… itttt! A new personal best! I'm 
sure Marine-chan is thrilled too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Cheval-san, 
Marine-chan-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...! I did it...! Thank 
you, Marine-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Watching Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, even though you were totally 
exhausted just now...!? That hat's effect 
is insane...
